articles.title: How One Ohio Town Became the Center of the Data Center Debate
articles.summary: Nick Owens and a statewide volunteer network are pushing ballot measures to block large data centers in Ohio, raising questions about farmland, secrecy, and local control.

articles.title: Inside Georgia's Push to Rebuild Trust in Elections
articles.summary: Georgia election workers are testing every voting machine before next month's midterms, as the state works to rebuild voter confidence.

articles.title: Trump Says He Is Ending Limits on Methane From Oil Drilling
articles.summary: President Trump announced the end of a Biden-era rule on methane from oil and gas drilling, a move supporters say saves money and critics say lets pollution continue.
